# ZapSales

> WhatsApp CRM with a Kanban pipeline, a shared inbox, AI agents and bulk campaigns over Meta's official WhatsApp API. Numbers connect through the official Meta Cloud API (recommended for campaigns) or through WAHA/QR code (support); whoever replies to a campaign lands in the pipeline and in the AI agent with the context of what was sent. Self-hosted and multi-tenant; runs on its owner's VPS (Hostinger) and its source code is public under a source-available license (PolyForm Noncommercial; commercial use requires a license).

Key facts:
- Category: WhatsApp CRM / bulk campaigns over the official API / AI sales agents
- Campaigns: bulk sends through the Meta Cloud API; replies enter the pipeline and the agent with the campaign's context
- AI: per-tenant RAG agents (pgvector) that answer, qualify and move leads; sentiment analysis; audited AI→human handoff; AI as first-class assignee; per-org AI budget; self-improvement loop (resolved conversations feed the knowledge base)
- MCP: internal MCP server today; public MCP contract on the roadmap — any AI agent can operate the CRM
- WhatsApp: official Meta Cloud API, plus WAHA (multi-number via QR code, anti-ban throttling, media, STOP detection)
- Multi-niche: configurable vocabulary per pipeline (lead = Customer/Patient/Buyer; won = Paid/Booked/Closed)
- Compliance: multi-tenant Postgres RLS (isolation tested in CI), LGPD by design (redact, data_request, anonymization), append-only audit log
- Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime + Storage), Vercel AI SDK, WAHA
- License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (source-available, not open source); commercial use requires a commercial license (see LICENSING.md). Self-hosted; your data stays on your VPS.
